# GaMa – Gavin Magid Web and Online Marketing Solutions

> Websites, online marketing/advertising, and AI-built apps and tools for doctors, accountants, therapists and self-employed professionals in South Africa.

GaMa (Gavin Magid Web and Online Marketing Solutions) is based in Johannesburg and works with clients across South Africa. Services: website design and build, Google/Facebook/Instagram advertising and SEO, and custom software (booking systems, client dashboards, internal tools) built with AI assistance for speed and lower cost, always designed and reviewed by a human.

## Pages
- [Home](https://www.gamaonlinemarketing.co.za/): services, process, FAQ, contact
- [Blog](https://www.gamaonlinemarketing.co.za/blog/): plain-English guides on websites, marketing and AI for small business
